title.en: Update 001 — Evaluation gets sharper; trustworthy autonomy remains open
title.zh: Update 001 — Evaluation 更扎实，Trustworthy Autonomy 仍未解决

summary.en: The post-cutoff signal is not a sudden leap to autonomous science. It is a shift toward decision-level holdouts, traceable long-horizon execution, artifact-aware review, stepwise verification, and real instrument operation. These advances strengthen evidence about agent behaviour, but do not establish genuine novelty or independent replication.
summary.zh: 本次 cutoff 之后的信号并非 Autonomous Science 的突然跃迁，而是向 Decision-level Holdout、可追踪的 Long-horizon Execution、Artifact-aware Review、Stepwise Verification 与 Real Instrument Operation 转移。这些进展增强了对 Agent 行为的证据，但尚不能证明 Genuine Novelty 或 Independent Replication。

takeaways.en: Most measurable progress comes from stronger Evaluation and Execution, not from solving Genuine Novelty.
takeaways.zh: 当前可测量的主要进步来自更强的 Evaluation 与 Execution，而非已解决 Genuine Novelty。

takeaways.en: Untouched Holdouts, Artifact-aware Review, Stepwise Verification, and Real Instrument Execution are becoming the strongest evidence patterns.
takeaways.zh: Untouched Holdout、Artifact-aware Review、Stepwise Verification 与 Real Instrument Execution 正成为更强的证据范式。

takeaways.en: Scientific Judgment, Independent Replication, Long-horizon Coherence, and Research Integrity remain the central bottlenecks.
takeaways.zh: Scientific Judgment、Independent Replication、Long-horizon Coherence 与 Research Integrity 仍是核心 Bottleneck。

takeaways.en: The most credible operating model remains Vibe Research / Human-on-the-loop rather than an unsupervised autonomous AI scientist.
takeaways.zh: 当前最可信的运行形态仍是 Vibe Research / Human-on-the-loop，而不是无人监督的 Autonomous AI Scientist。
